name: Charmed Tales: Colors of the Wind
source:
You play Thomas: the youngest recruit, the worst shot, and the only man aboard to have lost a sword fight against a coil of rope. Naturally, that made him the perfect choice to be sent up the river alone to scout for gold — mostly because nobody would miss him.

He loses the canoe over a waterfall and washes up soaked, trouser-less, and thoroughly out of his depth on Powhatan land — where he is promptly adopted by a fearless young woman, a four-hundred-year-old talking willow with a matchmaking hobby, and a raccoon who refuses to give back his pants.

What follows is six weeks of hopeless reports to a governor who only wants gold, escalating “cultural exchanges,” and one very determined tree that intends to see this through. Can the most spare man in the New World actually find something worth staying for?

[From [url=https://immoralstudios.itch.io/colors-of-the-wind-1]itch[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演托马斯：全船年纪最小的新兵、枪法最烂的射手，也是整艘船上唯一一个跟一捆绳子比剑都能败下阵来的家伙。理所当然地，这让他成了孤身一人溯流而上勘探黄金的绝佳人选——主要是因为就算他回不来，也没人会想念他。

谁知他的独木舟一头栽下瀑布摔得粉碎，他自己则浑身湿透、连裤子都丢了，狼狈不堪地被冲上了波瓦坦部族的领地——随即被一位无所畏惧的年轻姑娘、一棵活了四百岁且酷爱乱点鸳鸯谱的会说话的柳树，以及一只死活不肯把裤子还给他的浣熊当场“收养”了。

随之而来的，是长达六周向满脑子只有黄金的总督呈递绝望报告的苦差事、不断升温升级的“文化交流”，还有一棵铁了心要把这桩姻缘撮合到底的固执老树。这个新大陆上最可有可无的小卒子，究竟能否在这里找到真正值得留下来的归宿？
